% Invented fixture: \newenvironment with arguments. Two one-argument
% wrappers whose halves each contribute content around the body, and a
% zero-argument renewal. Nothing here derives from any private document.
\documentclass{article}

\newenvironment{labeled}[1]{\textbf{#1:}}{\emph{(end #1)}}
\newenvironment{aside}{}{}
\renewenvironment{aside}{Aside.}{}

\begin{document}

\begin{labeled}{First}
body one
\end{labeled}

\begin{aside}
body two
\end{aside}

\end{document}
